caption: The drawing depicts a square textile piece bordered by wide bands of red, tan, and blue fabric with contrasting stitched seams. In the center is an embroidered scene showing a four-legged animal, likely a fox, in a light gray or lavender color with a darker stitched outline, standing on the ground on its hind legs, while stretching upwards towards a wooden trellis. The trellis is brown and supports a vine with green leaves and several clusters of dark purple grapes. There are a few green plants and orange flowers depicted on the ground around the animal’s feet. The central embroidered panel is framed by a red border, which is in turn framed by alternating bands of tan, red, and blue fabric. At the bottom right corner of the piece, the name "ADOLF OPESTAD" is written in simple, uppercase letters.
title: Applique Coverlet (Detail)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
